newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Farm Council adopts regional food protection rules.
newsitem.headline: Farm Council adopts regional food protection rules.

text.p: Farm ministers on Monday agreed by qualified majority, without discussion, new rules to protect feta cheese and other regional food products from competitors using the same brand names.
Italy and Greece voted against the new rules that delay the start of a five-year transitional period to the date of registration of the food products.
The new rules were originally due to apply from the date of publication of Regulation 2081/92 in the EU Official Journal in July 1992.
The European Commission only approved a first list of protected regional food products in June 1996 and producers would not have had time to adapt before the original deadline expires in July 1997.
